info.name: server-moderation-session-service
info.description: server-moderation-session-service (Team 19, Topic 3 — Student ID, Please): shifts, the applicant queue, live updates (SSE) and the error contract, as of Lab 4 (`decision.recorded` arrives from the Message Broker; the REST stand-in is local only, see the queue folder). Run the folders top to bottom, or use the Collection Runner: later requests use {{sessionId}} and the applicant captured on the way. Calls go through the API Gateway (`baseUrl` http://localhost:8080) with the API key from the `apiKey` variable as `Authorization: Bearer` (one of the keys in GATEWAY_API_KEYS; never stored here). Every request sends its own `X-Request-Id` and checks that it comes back, and every error is checked for the `{error, message}` shape. The live stream is sent by hand (`watchLive`); instance status and metrics need `sessionInstanceUrl` (see those folders).

item.name: Queue And Event Stand-In (decision.recorded, stand-in local only)
item.description: `next-applicant` calls applicant-service (through the Gateway's internal port, or the Message Broker with `APPLICANT_CLIENT_MODE=broker`) and server-rules-service. Since Lab 4 `decision.recorded` arrives from the Message Broker over gRPC; `POST /internal/mock-events/decision-recorded` remains for local runs without a broker, only on an instance started with `MOCK_EVENTS_ENABLED=true` (never in Compose), and the Gateway no longer routes it. Set `standInUrl` to such an instance (e.g. `http://localhost:8082`); empty, the stand-in requests and the checks of their effect are skipped, the queue requests still run.

item.description: The shift's live updates. Event names and bodies: the CPR README, `server-moderation-session-service`, `GET /sessions/{id}/events`.

exec: // A stream stays open until the shift closes, so a run would wait here. Set watchLive to
// true and send this request by hand; then close the session from another tab.
// Runs only when you send it yourself with watchLive = true: the request ends when the stream does.

request.description: `GET /sessions/{id}/events`, Server-Sent Events through the Gateway. Set the variable `watchLive` to `true` and send this request: Postman shows `state` at once, then `applicant-presented` and `decision-recorded` as you send the matching requests from another tab, and `closed` (or `deleted`), which ends the stream. Skipped in runs (`watchLive` empty), because the request only ends with the stream. From a terminal: `curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" http://localhost:8080/sessions/<id>/events`.

item.name: Instance Status And Metrics (direct, local only)
item.description: `GET /health` (status with load and SSE streams, polled by the Service Discovery), `GET /actuator/prometheus` (scraped by Prometheus) and `GET /internal/logs` (the requests the Gateway's `GET /logs` collects, Lab 4) aren't routed by the Gateway, and Compose doesn't publish the instances' ports. Set `sessionInstanceUrl` to reach one instance directly (e.g. `http://localhost:8082` for a jar run locally, or `http://server-moderation-session-service:8082` for newman on the Compose network); empty, the two requests are skipped.
